budgets.rationale: The eagerly loaded application shell and route registry must stay below 450 kB minified.
React and React DOM are shared by every route and have an explicit 250 kB ceiling.
Router and query runtime shared by routes has an explicit 250 kB ceiling.
The reviewed Starknet and Wallet Standard runtime is shared by wallet-capable routes and is capped at 650 kB.
The browser HPKE implementation is isolated and capped at 300 kB.
Every other emitted browser JavaScript chunk has a fail-closed 650 kB ceiling.
